stateClasses.name: authentication-nonces-and-one-time-grants
invariants: a credential accepted once cannot be accepted a second time
expiration is enforced independently of application process lifetime

stateClasses.name: agent-request-anti-replay
invariants: the same signed request cannot win two concurrent verification attempts

stateClasses.name: machine-presence
invariants: claim and connection identity update are atomic
a stale connection cannot refresh another connection's presence

stateClasses.name: resource-and-scheduler-leases
invariants: lease renewal verifies ownership before extending ttl
lease release verifies ownership before delete
fencing tokens prevent a stale owner from acting as the current owner

stateClasses.name: workspace-gateway-relay
invariants: relay queues remain bounded by item and byte budgets
dequeue accounting and queue expiry are maintained
workspace relay state is not treated as durable business history

stateClasses.name: outbox-stream-publication
invariants: Postgres remains the durable outbox authority
Redis stream publication is a delivery surface and can be rebuilt from durable state

migrationRules: Do not replace Redis with plain Postgres CRUD or process memory.
A replacement must demonstrate atomic equivalents for every required semantic used by the migrated state class.
One-time credentials and anti-replay state must preserve consume-once behavior under concurrency.
Lease migrations must preserve ttl, ownership-checked renew/release and fencing.
Gateway queue migrations must preserve bounded queues and backpressure.
Durable audit and business lifecycle state belongs in Postgres; Redis is not the source of record for those domains.
Run fault and concurrency tests before changing REDIS_URL or removing Redis from a runtime role.
